Commentary.Commentary: The home side have a tough task ahead as they look to get a win in this series. A good start would be essential on this two-paced wicket which will surely make life difficult in the chase. Can they pull off a surprise? Join us in a short while for it.

Alzarri Joseph was the pick of the bowlers, ending with his career best figures of 10-0-76-4. West Indies skipper Jason Holder supported him brilliantly as he bagged three wickets himself. Both of them made most of the slowness of the deck and used the bounce well. They would have wanted more help from their fielders as they were sloppy in the field. The spinners failed to make an impact and allowed England to score freely.

The big man Stokes made his presence felt in the middle as he smacked a quick-fire 34 in just 20 balls. None of the other batsmen made it count as they lost 7 wickets in the last 10 overs looking for some quick runs.

An impressive batting performance by England. They looked positive from the first ball itself. Jason Roy departed early but Hales and Root joined hands to take up the mantle. Alex Hales, who came back in after a injury, proved his selection right as he scored his 5th ODI century. He stitched in a 192-run partnership with Root who looked struggling in the initial phase. The latter bounced back hard and added another century under his belt, only to get out the very next ball. Buttler and Morgan could not capitalize on the brilliant platform.

OUT! England bowled out for 328! Fuller on the stumps, Finn opens his shoulder and heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. He doesn't want the second but Plunkett is haring down for it. The throw comes in at the striker's end from Bishoo in the deep and the keeper, Hope has an entire eternity to run Liam out. Should Finn have run there? What if England lose by a run? Hmm. Anyway, they have enough for this wicket, by the looks of it.
Bowls a full toss on the stumps, Plunkett works it to deep square leg for a single.
SIX! Plunkett connects! Full outside off, Liam picks it and clobbers it over long off for a maximum. Handy that!

Comedy of errors! Fires it down the leg side watching Finn move around. The batsman misses and gets an inside edge towards the keeper, they attempt a bye as the keeper gets to the ball. He throws it towards mid on though, Holder gets across.
Deep mid-wicket in place now.
WIDE! Shorter length ball on middle, Finn cannot pull it. Another wide signaled.
WIDE! Slants it down the leg side. Finn cannot clip it, a wide is signaled.
Steven Finn will bat next.

OUT! Oh dear, Rashid is run out! Shorter outside off, Plunkett pulls it through square leg for a single. They want the second but it is not on. Plunkett wanted it at first but then sends Rashid back. The throw comes in quick onto the stumps from Kraigg Brathwaite and the keeper does the rest. A wicket gifted to Windies.
Fuller and slanting into the stumps, Liam backs away to smack it through the off side but misses.
SIX! Into the stands! Slower one outside off, Rashid picks it early and swings it over long on for a maximum. Top shot, that from the leg spinner!
A yorker from Carlos, Plunkett clips it towards long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, slammed down to long off for a single.
Slower outside off, Rashid looks to go over covers but splices it to the fielder in the deep and takes a brace.
Plunkett comes down the wicket and heaves it through mid-wicket for a single.
Slants it outside off, comes in sharply, Plunkett cannot put bat to ball and is beaten all ends up. The ball just bounced over the stumps.
Plunkett whips it through square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Plunkette gets across and defends it.
Adil Rashid is the next man in. Jason Holder is on a hat-trick ball.

OUT! Holder takes two in two! Fuller outside off, Stokes looks to go over covers but top edges it. Kraigg Brathwaite gets under it going behind from point and takes it safely. Holder takes another wicket and Stokes has to go back afte a cameo.
Liam Plunkett makes his way to the middle.

OUT! Woakes holes out! Shorter length outside off, Woakes looks to go over mid-wicket but does not keep it down. Bishoo comes in a touch from deep mid-wicket, dives forward and takes the catch well. That was hit against the wind and hence worked in favour of the bowler.
Too full outside off, Stokes gets it behind point with an angled bat for a single.
Fuller outside off, Woakes mistimes his loft to long on for a single.
Jason Holder brings himself back into the attack.
Slower ball on the stumps, Woakes clips it through square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Stokes manages to squeeze it to deep point for a single.
Shorter in length, Stokes works it through square leg for a single. 300 up for England!
Fuller outside off, Woakes looks to drive but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
WIDE! Slower bouncer from Carlos but it is down the leg side, Woakes cannot pull it through. A wide is signaled.
FOUR! Goes up and over! Fuller outside off, Woakes makes room for himself and carves it over extra cover for a boundary. These are vital runs for it.
Slower one outside off, does not get up at all, Woakes fails to put bat to ball.
Carlos Brathwaite is back for a bowl.
Woakes lofts it over covers for a single to retain the strike.
Stokes looks to go for the slog sweep but gets an inside edge towards the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Smacked! Short outside off, Stokes does not miss out and slaps it over extra cover for a boundary. The long off fielder cannot cut it off.
Flatter outside off, bounces more on Stokes who is beaten on his whack at that one. The keeper does well to jump and collect the ball.
Fires it down the leg side, Woakes cannot clip it away. They scamper through for a leg bye.
Flatter outside off, pushed towards covers.
Fuller in length on the stumps, Woakes slams it to long on for a single. That ends the spell for Joseph. His match figures are 10-0-76-4! Expensive but effective, remember he had Root dropped!

NOT OUT! What a waste of a review! Angles it on the stumps, Stokes looks to clip it through but misses and is hit on his pads. The players go up in an appeal but the umpire stays put. The keeper for the hosts, Hope wants it reviewed. Holder from long on, comes in, wondering if anyone needs his help. He too signals a review, may be for himself. Replays show it pitched outside leg and the matter ends there. A review wasted. They crossed for a leg bye. Just so we all know.
West Indies go upstairs for an LBW review against Ben Stokes.
FOUR! Powerful! Fuller on the stumps, Stokes slams it through mid on. Holder looks to cut it off from long on but the ball beats him to the fence.

FOUR! Edged! On a good length on the stumps, Stokes looks to pull it with a short-arm jab but gets a top edge. The ball actually took off and went off the edge over the short third man fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! In the gap! Fuller outside off, Stokes gets under it and carves it over extra cover for a boundary. Superb shot, that!
Fuller outside off, Woakes drives it on the up towards extra cover for a single.
Fuller on off, Woakes clips it towards mid on. The fielder fumbles and that allows the single.
Lands it outside off, Woakes stays back and defends it watchfully.
Fuller on off, Stokes whips it through mid on for a single.
Stokes kneels down and slog sweeps it in between long on and deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Shorter outside off, Stokes punches it towards mid off from his back foot.
Fuller on the middle, Stokes turns it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Chris Woakes is the next man in.

OUT! Joseph takes four! Fuller in length on middle and leg, Ali looks to clip it through but ends up chipping it back to the bowler. Joseph goes to his left and takes it safely. That's two big wickets in the over for him. England are losing their way here.
Shorter on the stumps, Stokes gets across and tucks it through square leg for a single.
Moeen Ali makes his way to the pitch to replace Joe Root.

OUT! TON AND GONE! Fuller in length around off, Root looks to whip it wide of long on but fails to get the required connection. Carlos at long on gets across, under it and pouches the catch. England needed him to play through  but he is gone now. West Indies are doing well towards the end here. Root gets an ovation as he walks back. Been a fighting knock for England.
9th ODI hundred for Joe Root.

CENTURY! Shorter outside off, Root gets on top of that one and pulls it through square leg for a couple. Chants of Rooooot, are on around the ground. He has had his fair share of luck but he has made the most of it. He raises his arms to celebrate the ton. He gets a warm applause for it.
Fuller outside off, Root lunges across and clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Full toss outside off, Stokes clips it to long on for a single.
Alzarri Joseph is called back into the attack.
Fuller outside off, Stokes works it through mid on for a single.
SIX! Going, going, gone! Lands it outside off, Stokes is beaten in the air as he comes down the track. He goes through with the shot and gets a maximum for it.
Stokes covers the line of the ball and defends it towards short mid-wicket.
Fires it down the leg side, Root looks to paddle it but gloves it past the keeper for a single.
Fuller on middle, Stokes clips it through mid on for a single. 250 up for England!
Ben Stokes walks out to the middle.

OUT! West Indies are coming back! Flatter on the stumps, Morgan looks to go back and chop it through but fails to connect cleanly. He gets an inside edge onto his stumps. Nurse celebrates the wicket and why not, the hosts are getting back in the contest here.
Ashley Nurse is back into the attack.
Back of a length outside off, Morgan pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Edged! Outside off on a length, Morgan looks to chop it through but gets a bottom edge back to the keeper.
Shorter outside off, Morgan pulls this hard towards short mid-wicket.

SIX! That almost worked, the short ball! Bangs it short around off, Morgan expecting it, swivels and goes for the hook. The ball flies off the top edge over Bishoo at deep square leg for a maximum. The breeze took the ball over the fielder there.
Edged! Outside off on a length, Root looks to clip it but gets it off the outer half for a single.
Slower one outside off, kicks off, Root looks to wait for it to guide it down to third man but is beaten all ends up. Root is surprised by that one.
Powerplay 3 has been taken. Five fielders are allowed the 30-yard circle.
On a length on off, Root heaves it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, Morgan pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
That spat! Slants it fuller outside off, kicks off. Morgan sits low to crash it through but fails to put bat to ball. That bounced more than expected!
Fuller outside off, Morgan comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Shorter one again, Root works it down to fine leg for a single.
Guides this one towards point from his crease.
Slants it across on a good length, Morgan shoulders his arms to it.
WIDE! Bouncer from Holder which is way too short, Morgan first thought to hit it away but it was too away from him.
Well played! Waits for this one outside off on a length, dabs it down to third man for a single.
Shorter again, Morgan tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Slower one, fuller outside off, Root drives it through covers for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Root stays back and defends it.
On a length outside off, Morgan defends it towards the on side for a single.
Carlos Brathwaite returns for a bowl.
Bangs it shorter on off, Morgan is taken back by the bounce on that one and gloves it towards the on side for a single.
Ouch! Shorter in length on the stumps, does not bounce much, Morgan takes his eyes off that one and is hit on his shoulder. Welcome to the crease, Mr. Morgan!
Eoin Morgan walks in next.

OUT! Timber! Fires it full and on the stumps, Buttler gets across to paddle it but misses and has his furniture disturbed. A gamble that does not work for Buttler, another failure for him. A vital wicket for the hosts.
Slants it on a length on the stumps, Buttler gets across to scoop it but misses.
Shorter outside off, does not get up at all, Root punches it through covers at the last moment for a single.
On a length outside off, Root defends it from his crease.
Jason Holder called back on.
Slower one outside off, Buttler comes forward and defends it.
Shorter in length outside off, Root controls the pull and gets it towards deep square leg. The fielder gets across from deep mid-wicket, dives full stretch to his right and stops a run for his side.
Carves this one through point for a single.

SIX! Joseph gives a gift to Buttler who accepts it with glee! In the zone, just outside off, Buttler is the last one to miss out and sends it packing over long off for a maximum. What a way to get off the mark.
What a gift for Buttler to start his innings!
Free Hit coming up!
No ball! Length ball outside off, Root dabs it towards point for a single.
BOLDSTARTS Jos Buttler BOLDENDS is the new man in!
Jos Buttler is the new man in.

OUT! Hales holes out! Slower one outside off, Hales goes for the big shot over long off. The ball goes off the top edge and is in the air for ages. Ashley Nurse gets under it at short fine leg and pouches a safe catch. That ends a terrific knock by the England opener and he may feel he has thrown it away but there are plenty of hitters to follow for his side.
WIDE! Sprays this one too wide outside off, Hales cannot reach it. A wide is signaled.
Fuller outside off, Hales gives himself too much room but misses it.
Spots Hales coming down, fires it full outside leg, Hales clips it through mid-wicket for a run to retain the strike.
SIX! Hales goes Boom! Flatter on the stumps, Hales gets under it and swings it over mid-wicket for a maximum. His fifth biggie!
This time Root gets it too square and the deep point fielder cuts it off and keeps the batsmen to a single.
FOUR! Class from Joe! Lands it outside off, Root unfurls a reverse sweep through backward point for a boundary. There was no stopping that one.
Hales comes down and clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter outside off, Hales pushes it to covers.
Drinks.
Hales heaves this one down to long on for a single.
Angles it on a length on the stumps, Hales back away to smash it over mid-wicket but misses.
5th ODI hundred for Alex Hales.

SIX! Century! Hales announces his arrival! Not quite the way to get to it but he won't mind it. Shorter one from Alzarri, Hales is in no position yet goes for the hook. The ball flies off the top edge down into the fine leg fence. He raises his arms to celebrate the ton and why shouldn't he? He has played superbly and done what England were missing from Billings - score a big one.
Angles it on a length outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Short and wide outside off, Root does not miss out and crashes it over point for a boundary. Bad start to the over for Alzarri.
Shorter outside off, Hales chops it down to third man for a single.
Alzarri Joseph returns for a bowl.
Fuller on the stumps, Root looks to clip it through but finds the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Shorter outside off, Hales punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Bowls it on the stumps, Root clips it through square leg for a single.
What happened there? Floats it outside off, Hales looks to go big but misses. The ball kept low there and beats the keeper too. They cross for a bye.

NOT OUT! Good review, Alex! Brathwaite bowls this one on the stumps, Hales sits low and looks to sweep it through but misses and is rapped on the pads. The bowler appeals long and hard, the umpire after a thought, gives it out. Alex Hales goes for the review right away. Replays confirm that there was no bat there and the Ball Tracker shows it to be going past the off stump. A good review from Hales and West Indies' poor day continues.
Hales has gone upstairs to review the LBW decision against him.
Bowls it outside of, Hales looks to work it through but finds the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Too full outside off, Root opens the face of his bat and guides it towards the fielder at short third man.
Good length delivery outside off, Root steers it through the backward point region for a couple.
Short delivery down the leg side, Hales works it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Down the leg side, Root tucks it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Full into the stumps, Root pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Full outside off, Root dances down the track and goes for a heave. He gets a thick outside edge which races through the third man region for a boundary.
Quicker delivery into the pads, the ball was quite flat this time. Catches Hales by surprise and he is hit low on the pads.
Again on the pads, Root pushes it through mid-wicket for a single.
Down the leg side, Hales clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Tossed up outside off, Root punches it through covers for a single.
150-run stand up between Root and Hales!
FOUR! Short delivery sprayed outside leg, Root adjust well and pulls it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Kraigg Brathwaite comes on for a bowl.
Tossed outside off, Root cuts it through the point region for a single.
Down the leg side, Root clips it through the backward square leg region for a couple.
Full delivery into the stumps, Hales drives it through the mid on region for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Hales tries to cut but gets cramped for room and is beaten.
Full delivery on the pads, Root clips it through the square leg region for a single.
FOUR! Short delivery into the body, the ball keeps low. Root adjusts well and drags it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
A flatter one outside off, Hales looks to dab it through but finds the fielder at short third man.
Root sits low and paddles it towards square leg for a single.
On the stumps, Root turns it towards the leg side.
Hales square drives this one for a single through point.
Pushes this one to covers for a single.
21st ODI fifty for Joe Root!

Fifty! Root gets to his milestone in style! A full toss from Nurse, Root makes most of it by reverse sweeping it through third man for a boundary. He was given life twice and he has made the most of it.
FOUR! Short delivery outside off, Hales hangs back and pulls it brilliantly through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
On the pads, Root flicks it square of the wicket on the leg side for a single.
Down the leg side, Root clips it on the leg side.
Hales punches it through the point region for a single.
Root predetermines the scoop at first and then guides it towards the third man region for a single.
Root stays deep in his crease and mistimes his defence it back to the bowler.
Driven towards the mid off region.
SIX! Tossed up outside off, Hales gets down on one knee and swings his bat to smack the ball over the long on region for a maximum.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full on the pads, Hales clips it through the square leg region for a single.
Flatter delivery outside off, Hales guides this one towards the fielder at third man.
FOUR! Innovation! Floated outside off, Hales plays the predetermined reverse sweep fine through backward point for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, Hales tries to push at it but gets a thick inside edge towards the fielder at short fine leg for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Hales punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Angling into the pads, Root works it through the square leg region for a single.
Full into the stumps, Hales clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Root stays deep in his crease and runs it down towards third man for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another change, Jonathan Carter is the new bowler for WI.
Floated up in the line of the stumps, Hales drives it down the ground. Nurse dives to his right to make a fine stop.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Root cuts it through the point region for a single.
Root gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Hales gets to the pitch of the ball and eases it towards long on for a single.
Full into the stumps, Root drives it down the ground towards long on for a single.
Full delivery outside off, Root drives it uppishly towards the fielder at covers. The ball falls just short of him.
Short delivery outside off, Root guides it towards third man for a single to keep strike.
Down the leg side, Hales clips it off his pads for a single through square leg.

In the air but safe! Length delivery outside off, Hales stays in his crease and goes for a biggie. He gets it off the bottom edge of the bat. The ball balloons towards the vacant mid-wicket region. Three men after eying it but none can get to it. The batsmen manage to run a couple in the process.
Short delivery sprayed down the leg side, Hales fails to make the most of it as he pulls it straight towards the fielder at short fine leg.
Good length delivery outside off, Root punches it through point for a single.
100-run stand between Hales and Root!
Full delivery down the leg side, Hales clips it through the square leg region for a single. It has been a good stand by these two in the middle.
FOUR! Top shot! Shortish delivery outside off, Root camps back and pulls it feircely through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Outside off, Root gets down and tries to pull but manages to get a top edge over the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Floated outside off, Hales dances down the track and clips it over mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, Hales shuffles across and sweeps it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Short outside off, Hales stays deep in his crease and defends it towards the mid on region.
Full delivery outside off, Hales drives it through the cover region for a couple.
Length delivery outside off, the ball stays a bit low. Root slays at it but is unable to make contact.
Good length delivery outside off, Hales pushes it through covers for a single.
Down the leg side, Hales clips it towards the square leg region. No runs taken.
Shorter delivery angling into the stumps, Hales shapes to pull it through but gets it towards mid on off the bottom half.
Dug in short outside off, Hales goes to play the hook but misses.
Angling into the stumps from back of a length, Hales tries to pull it but the ball stays a bit low. The ball hits him on the thigh pad.
Change of ends for Carlos Brathwaite.
Down the leg side, Hales nudges it down the leg side for a single.
Full into the stumps, Hales pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated outside off, Hales gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards the fielder at extra-cover.
This one is outside off, Hales looks to defend but the ball goes past the outside edge.
Fuller on the stumps, Hales goes for a biggie but gets an inside edge which goes towards short fine leg.
Short and wide outside off, Hales cuts it late towards the fielder at point.
Ashley Nurse comes on for a bowl.
Floated in the line of the stumps, Root goes for the sweep but misses it completely.
Shorter delivery outside off, Root punches it through cover-point for a single.
Fuller delivery outside off, Hales drives it towards long off for a single.
WIDE! Way down the off side. The umpire signals it as a wide.
FOUR! Short delivery, Hales stays in his crease and cuts it late through the point region for a boundary.
7th ODI fifty for Alex Hales!
FOUR! Pierced! Full toss outside off, Hales drives it crisply through the cover region for a boundary. A brilliant knock till now and he will want to make it big.
SIX! Brilliant! Tossed up outside off, Hales sits down and lofts it over the long off region for a biggie.
Down the leg side from a shorter length, Root stays deep in his crease and works it towards mid-wicket.
Angling into the stumps, Root camps back and defends it.
Good length delivery outside off, Root punches it towards the fielder at point.
A bit short into the pads, Hales stays in his crease and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Angling into the stumps, Root clips it square of the wicket on the leg side for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Root defends it towards the fielder at point.
On the pads, Hales clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple. 10 runs off the last over.
Hales stays deep in his crease and defends it.
SIX! In the arc....out of the park! Tossed up delivery outside off, Hales reads the length well, gets under the ball and smacks it over the long on region for a biggie.
Floated on the pads, Root clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker one at 91 kmph, Root camps back and defends it.
Full delivery into the pads, Hales clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Hales gets an outside edge towards the fielder at third man for a single.
WIDE! Just down the leg side, Hales tries to clip it but misses. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Length delivery outside off, Hales pushes it towards the fielder at point.
Another one which stays low, down the leg side this time. Root works it towards fine leg for a single.
Slower delivery outside off, Root stays in his crease and defends it.
Short delivery around off, Root punches it towards covers from his crease.
Angling into the pads from a fuller length, Root clips it straight towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Drinks break, official one.
Outside off, Hales pushes it towards the fielder at point.
Tossed up outside off, Hales goes for a drive but misses it. He was beaten by the away spin.
Into the stumps, Hales stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Floated in the line of the stumps, Root works it around the leg side for a single.
50-run stand up between Root and Hales!

Pitched in short and this was the carrom ball, Root camps back and pulls it over the mid-wicket region. Keiran Powell from deep-micket rushes to his right and makes a fine stop to save the boundary. Two runs taken.
Tossed up full outside off, Hales drives it down the ground towards long on for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Hales punches it through covers for a single to keep strike.
On the pads, Alex clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Angling into the pads, Hales stays in his crease and defends it.
Short delivery outside off, Root pulls it towards the fielder at mid on for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Hales guides it past point for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Down the leg side, Hales just shuffles a bit and pills it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Evin Lewis is going off the field, holding his left arm.
Evin Lewis has hurt himself as he is lying and all the players and the physio are there to check on him. Looks quite serious.

Ouch! Fuller outside off, Root waits for this one and drives it through cover-point. Lewis from cover and the point fielder hare after it. Lewis gets to it first and parries it back into play. The fielder from point returns the ball. Two runs taken in the meanwhile. But Lewis slipped after getting past the ropes and looks to be in terrible pain. He must have hurt himself, running with the spikes on the concrete surface past the boundary.
Shorter from Bishoo, Root arches back and punches it to the fielder at cover.
FOUR! Clobbered! Lands it on off, Root picks the length and goes for the slog sweep. He connects well and gets a boundary through mid-wicket.
Flatter outside off, Root looks to drive it through but fails to put bat to ball.
Floats it outside off, Root comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Bowls it outside off, Root gets across and paddles it down to fine leg for a couple of runs. England are intent to not letting Bishoo settle.
Shorter and angling on the stumps, Root pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
On a length outside off, Hales works it through backward square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Hales gets across and defends it.
Shorter in length outside off, Root again comes down to pull it over mid-wicket but again does not connect well and gets it to the fielder in the deep for a single.
Fuller outside off, Root times this push back down the wicket to the bowler. He is slowly getting into rhythm.
On a length on off, Root looks to defend but does not quite manage to do it.
Carlos Braithwaite is called into the attack for the first time today.
Hales looks to punch it through but does not beat the fielder in the ring on the off side.
Goes back again and defends another short ball from Bishoo.
Shorter outside off, Hales goes back and punches it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Poor start for Bishoo! This time Hales waits for this shorter one to come, he gets it past the cover fielder for a boundary.
Short and flatter outside off, Hales shapes to cut it through but fails to connect.
Floats it outside off, Hales drives it towards extra cover.
Devendra Bishoo is introduced into the attack.
An unofficial drinks break for the English batsmen.
Edged! Short outside off, Hales throws his bat at it. The ball goes down to third man for a single.
Length ball outside off, Root guides it down to third man for a single.
Fuller outside off, Root creams his push to mid off.
On a length outside off, bounces more on Root who arches back and pushes it towards gully.
Fuller outside off, Hales looks to go hard through covers but gets it to the right of the bowler for a single. Mid off fielder cuts it off.
FOUR! On a length just around off, Hales picks it up and sends it packing through backward square leg for a boundary. That was sweet!
Fuller outside off, Hales looks to defend but gets an inside edge through square leg for a single.
Clipped through mid-wicket for a single.

What an effort, Nurse! Angles it on the stumps, Root looks to defend but gets an outside edge. Nurse from gully flies to his right and looks to take it with his right hand but the ball does not stick. Another life given to Joe Root. Holder walks back dejected.
FOUR! Lucky Root! Good length on the stumps, Root looks to work it through the on side but gets an inside edge over his stumps and to the left of the keeper for a boundary.
Shorter outside off, Root looks to punch it off his back foot but finds the fielder.
Back of a length outside off, Root is right behind it and defends it.
Second Powerplay has been taken. Four fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle now.
Fuller outside off, Root drives it hard and finds mid off. Holder misfields a touch and allows a single.
WIDE! Bouncer from Joseph, Root shapes to pull but misses as it is too high.
FOUR! Ordinary stuff! On a length outside off, Root drives it on the up through covers. The fielder at covers allows it through and Root gets a boundary. Lewis is the fielder again.

On a length around off, Root comes out of his crease and looks to smack it over mid-wicket but gets it off the bottom half towards the fielder inside the ring. He has not got used to the conditions yet.
On a length outside off, Root punches it towards point off his crease.
Fuller outside off, Root presses forward and guides it towards point but not for any run.
On a length on the stumps, Hales clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Angles this on a length just around off, Root defends it from his crease.
This time Root gets right behind the line and defends it.
Back of a length outside off, Root again mistimes his punch off his crease and gets an inside edge.
Fuller in length outside off, Holder pushes it towards mid on from his crease. By the time the fielder gets to it and returns the ball, they take a single.
Too short and wide outside off, Root guides it down to third man with a punch for a single.
On a fuller length outside off, Root is again trapped on his pads as he fails to clip it. Mild appeal turned down. Holder is getting some good bounce here.
Hales times this punch back down the wicket but the bowler manages to halt it in his followthrough.
Angles it on a shorter length, this one bounces a lot and hits the splice of the bat of Hales.
Roy clips it towards mid on from his crease.
This one is left alone by Joe Root.

Dropped! On a length on the stumps, Root looks to clip but hits it in the air towards square leg. Evin Lewis gets across from mid-wicket and dives to his right. He gets two hands to it but fails to get hold on it. You need to take those, on this level of cricket.
Hurls it outside off on a length, this one does not get up and beats Root on his waft at it.
Fuller in length on the stumps, Hales presses forward and defends it. A maiden from Holder.
Back of a length outside off, Hales defends it back.

On a length outside off, comes in a long way, Root looks to defend it from his crease but fails to put bat to ball. There is a loud appeal for an lbw but nothing from the umpire. They think about the review but do not go for it. Replays show they were right as it was going over the stumps. A leg bye taken.
Ouch! Angles it on a good length outside off, the ball jags back in and hits Root on his back leg as he hops to defend that one. That seamed back in and bounced a lot too.
This one is on a length but wide outside off, left alone.
Almost! On a length just around off, Root looks to clip it away but does so rather awkwardly towards the on side. That almost carried to the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Good length outside off, Root dabs it towards third man for a single.
Joe Root will bat at number 3.

OUT! Alzarri strikes! Fuller in length just outside off, Roy looks to go for another of his on the up drives. The timing is not right and Jason Holder at mid off, takes a simple catch. That is the end of Roy, a soft dismissal really.
Fuller in length on off, Roy again drives it back down the wicket to the bowler.
Shorter in length on off, Roy pulls it wide of mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller outside off, Roy punches his drive towards mid on but the bowler goes to his left and stops it.
Angles it on a length outside off, Roy looks to defend it with his bat and pad close to each other and gets the ball towards covers.
Angles it on a length on off, Hales gets behind in line and defends it.
Hales presses forward and drives it towards covers from his crease.
Fuller in length on off, Hales clips it towards fine leg.
Outside off, Hales gets in line and defends it.
Outside off, Roy dabs it towards the point region and takes a quick single. Holder is not impressed.
Fuller on the pads, Hales clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Good length outside off, guided behind point for a single.
Shorter again on the stumps, Roy works it with a horizontal bat shot through backward square leg for a single.
Too full on the pads, Hales clips it to fine leg for a single.

Fuller length outside off, Roy mistimes his loft wide of the mid on fielder. Luckily for him, it does not carry to the fielder. Roy has tried to hit a lot of balls on the up, coming forward. A run taken.
FOUR! In the gap! Angles it on a shorter length, Roy is not troubled though and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary. This is a good start for England!
Fuller outside off, Roy gets across and defends it watchfully.
Hurls it on a length outside off, Hales gets behind the line and defends it.
Angles it fuller on the stumps, Hales keeps it out with a forward press.
FOUR! Too good! A nothing length - good length, angling into the pads, asking to be hit, Hales gets on top of it,  swivels and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, Hales defends it from his crease.
Just wide! Fuller in length on off, Roy looks to clip but the ball hits the splice of the bat and falls wide of the mid on fielder going to his right.
Shorter in length around the stumps, Roy looks to pull it over mid-wicket but the ball gets big on him and falls short of the fielder at short mid-wicket. Jason Mohammad was the fielder.
On a length outside off, Hales punches it through covers for a brace.
Hurls it outside off on a good length, Hales tucks it towards square leg from his crease.
Fuller and targeting the stumps, Hales clips it towards mid on from his crease.
On a length around off, Roy presents the full face of the bat and gets it wide of mid off for a single.
Shorter in length on off, Hales wants to pull but does so with an awkward looking crouch. He gets a single to fine leg and gets off the mark.
Fuller outside off but wide enough to be left alone by Alex Hales.
Alzarri Joseph will bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
On a length on off, Roy turns it towards mid-wicket and comes back for the second by the time the fielder gets to it and returns the ball. A good end to the over for England!
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller outside off, Roy presses forward and just lofts it through the line for a boundary through mid off.
Good stop, Carter! Shorter outside off, Roy punches it towards point expecting a boundary but Carter dives to his right and stops the ball.
Angles it on a length, goes away late. Roy spots that it is wide enough and leaves it.
A back of a length delivery outside off, Roy punches it on the up towards covers but cannot get a run for it.
Starts off with a length ball outside off, Roy presses forward and pushes it into covers.
The players are out in the middle for start of play. The two England openers are Alex Hales and Jason Roy. Jason Holder to begin with the new ball.

Pitch Report - Jeffrey Dujon doing the report reckons that there is a good covering of grass. The surface underneath also has grass and it looks firm. He expects it to play well and may get better to bat in the second innings. Adds that the pacers will get some help early on but batsmen will enjoy the ball coming onto the bat.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan says that Jason Roy and Alex Hales have been a formidable pair for quite sometime now which made it a straightforward choice to get the latter back in the side. Also adds that the pitch seems to be a really good one with the cover of grass on it. Talks about the injury concerns which have been troubling them for a while. Ends by saying that the third win would be an icing on the cake.

West Indies skipper, Jason Holder feels that the grass on the wicket should help them to get some movement upfront. Also adds that they would want to entertain the crowd who turn out in huge numbers every time they play. Ends by saying that this game is an important encounter in the context of their qualification for the World Cup.
TOSS - WEST INDIES WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BOWL! One change for the hosts, Alzarri Joseph comes in for Shannon Gabriel. The visitors make a solitary change too. Alex Hales called in for Sam Billings.

The visitors on the other hand, are aiming to build a stable team leading to the Champions Trophy and they will know they have work left to be done. The top order has not quite come through together and they will aim to get some vital time in the middle and put in a complete performance and take the series 3-0.

The hosts have had their moments in both the games but have failed to close out games. They are on Number 9 in the ICC ODI rankings and a few more losses and it would rule them out from qualifying automatically for the upcoming ICC World Cup 2019. A win today puts them above Pakistan at Number 8 and that should be enough motivation for them to put up a strong show.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the third and final ODI between West Indies and England at Kensington Oval, Bridgetown, Barbados. The visitors have already sealed the series with a close win in the previous encounter but there is still a lot at stake for both the teams and it promises to be another intense battle.
